prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Desktop Controls", "Try dragging your pet around your desktop or right-clicking to access shortcuts.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or toggle your pet.", "Got It, Finish!"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Choose a companion that lives right on your desktop, keeps you company, and brightens your workday."]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's First Accessory", "Pick a starting accessory to style your new companion before finalizing adoption.", "Starter Accessory", "Continue"]
3: ["Pick Your Pet Companion", "Browse through available pets and pick the companion that best matches your desk setup."]
4: ["Your pet will appear near your taskbar once assets finish loading. Keep the app running!"]
5: ["Your Pet is Active! Press Ctrl+Shift+P to Open Menu", "Click on your desktop pet to interact, or use Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to adjust settings, talk, or hide your companion."]
6: ["Quick path takes under 60 seconds. Custom path allows full pet personality setup."]
7: ["Test Pet Audio & Desktop Alerts", "Play a sample chirp to confirm your desktop audio and notifications are active.", "Play Sample", "Looks Good"]
8: ["Founder Companion Badge Unlocked!"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially registered to your desktop! Click below to complete registration."]
